name: stomp
notes: The yard heaving: grey-blue stone shards (the statue's stone) burst up one after another to 22 px at the front, tip back and sink as the wave passes; stone chips and moss bits thrown up, bouncing and settling; a dark crack splitting the floor; dust kicked up at the front and rolling behind. Low: jump it. Facing +x, exported in place (12 frames @ 12 fps, seamless loop). Feet anchor: ground is canvas row 40; the front's leading edge is at canvas x 60; place that point on the ring's position.
